title: OffsetBias: Leveraging Debiased Data for Tuning Evaluators
reasoning: The paper focuses on identifying and mitigating stylistic and structural biases (such as length, concreteness, and familiar knowledge) in LLM-based evaluators. While it utilizes benchmarks that include safety and harmlessness components, the primary focus is on evaluator robustness rather than evaluating religion, faith, or specific moral/ethical systems.
